summary: Iteration 48 backend regression — Apr 24, 2026 candlestick + MTF + volume validation feature group + SelectKBest k=70 bump. 13/13 pytest cases PASSED. Endpoint surface, unit-level feature extraction, and prior-iteration regression all green.
critical_code_review_comments: ml_accuracy_tuner.py is 772 lines — borderline against the 700-line guideline. As more feature groups land, consider splitting candlestick / MTF / volume helpers into a feature_extractors/ submodule.

_extract_candlestick_patterns at L399-401: the boolean expression `c3 < o3 is False` is hard to read (chained `is` interacts oddly with comparison). Prefer `(c3 >= o3)` for clarity. Functionally evaluates correctly here because Python parses `c3 < o3 is False` as `(c3 < o3) and (o3 is False)` — `o3` is a float so this is always False, meaning the three-white-soldiers pattern can NEVER fire. This is a likely bug introduced with the new code: pattern flag will always be 0. Suggest E1 rewrite to `c3 >= o3 and c2 > o2 and pc > po and is_bull and c > pc > c2 and o > o2` or drop the c3 condition if intent was 'no requirement on bar -4'.

_extract_mtf_features L443: `tail = close[-(window * 40):]` caps history at 40 buckets — fine for 15s (120 bars) and 1m (480 bars). With idx=75 only 76 bars are available, so 1m aggregation returns at most 6 buckets, which is below the rsi(period=14) and macd(26) thresholds. The fallback paths (`if len(c1m) >= 15 ... else rsi_5s`) handle this correctly so no NaN, but downstream `mtf_macd_sign_1m` returns 0 silently. Fine in current spec but worth noting that real lift from the 1m timeframe needs ≥312 bars to engage the macd signals.

extract_5s_features still ignores the `timestamp` column for the new feature groups; if the caller passes a df without timestamp the hour_sin/hour_cos block falls back to 0 (already handled). Good defensive default.
/api/ml/tuning-report does not currently surface the *count* of total selected features (only k_bumped_to=70). Minor: add `total_feature_pool` int alongside `k_bumped_to` for observability.
No regression on iteration 47's signal.beta — TestSignalsRegression.test_force_generate_v2_envelope confirms `signal.beta` is present and a bool.

rca of the issue: No active bugs in iteration 48 scope. The 3-white-soldiers chained-comparison issue at L399-401 is pre-existing-style code (could have been introduced with this PR per file references). It does not break tests because the pattern silently stays at 0; ML training will simply receive a constant-zero feature for that one pattern. Mitigation: replace `c3 < o3 is False and c2 > o2 ...` with `c3 >= o3 and c2 > o2 ...`.
